entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A deep chasm in Stensia's Geier Reach on Innistrad, gateway for demons and devils, transformed by Emrakul's arrival.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region of Innistrad containing Geier Reach.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi titan whose arrival on Innistrad transformed the Ashmouth.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon who introduced vampirism to Innistrad through Edgar Markov and emerged from the Ashmouth.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Vampire through whom Shilgengar introduced vampirism.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon freed from the Helvault and destroyed at the Ashmouth by Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who pursued and destroyed Griselbrand.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel freed from the Helvault whose angels destroyed many demons.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Prison whose destruction in 4558 AR freed Avacyn and Griselbrand.

entities.name: Devilthorn Lodge
entities.description: Reclaimed tower overlooking the Ashmouth, base for devil hunters.

entities.name: Kastinne
entities.description: Mother who entered the Ashmouth to free her murdered children's souls; later driven mad by Emrakul.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Hunter who trained and worked with Kastinne.

entities.name: Paulin
entities.description: A trapper who fared well against Ashspawn demons.

events.summary: The Helvault's destruction frees Avacyn and Griselbrand; Liliana pursues and destroys Griselbrand at the Ashmouth.
events.quote: Liliana Vess pursued Griselbrand from Thraben to the Ashmouth, and destroyed him utterly there.

events.summary: Kastinne enters the Ashmouth, frees her children's souls and kills the demon.
events.quote: She succeeded and killed the demon

events.summary: Emrakul arrives and transforms the Ashmouth, spawning corrupted Ashspawn demons.
events.quote: Emrakul's presence physically transformed the Ashmouth.

events.summary: Kastinne is driven mad by Emrakul, warped into a demonic form, and hunts humans.
events.quote: Kastinne was driven mad by Emrakul's influence

relations.quote: a deep chasm in Stensia 's Geier Reach on Innistrad
trained and worked with Rem Karolus afterwards
